_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
A si Mangu {player_id} e Tic Tac Toe.
Himmol maɓɓe o woni ko yahri koɗol ngal three e yankooji (ko wonande, ko vertikaali, walla ko diagonal) e bortu.
E turna maɓɓe, ka siyaa woodi numeeru (0-8) o si woodi alaaamaji maɓɓe e hakkunde o si woodi ɗum.
Ko faɗɗii, '[4]' woodi alaaamaji maɓɓe e hakkunde bortu.
Ko Mangu {player_id}, a si '{symbol}', ko ko wonande o si '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jaɓɓorgo Daartol ngol ɗon tokka laawol je wooɗi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} naa cell je ɗon nafo. Gotta be hakkude 0 e 8.

game_action.placed: Mangu {player_id} ina woodi alaaamaji ({symbol}) e hakkunde {cell}.
